title: Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity Regulates Triplet formation in Heliobacterial Photosynthesis
summary: Triplet formation and its regulation have always been of central interest in understanding the photophysical behavior of living systems. In organic systems, excessive triplet formation poses significant challenges, as it can promote photochemical damage and reduce the efficiency of charge separation processes, making its regulation critically important.Here, we present a theoretical investigation of the intrinsic quantum spin dynamics governing triplet formation in the heliobacterial reaction center, a system that operates without any internal magnetic field.
